description: Federal contracts, IDVs, grants, loans and direct payments from USAspending.gov by recipient, awarding agency (name or abbreviation such as DOD, NASA, HHS), NAICS code or keyword, for a date range (default last 12 months). Returns the top awards by amount or start date with award id, recipient and UEI, amount, outlays, dates, agency and sub-agency, award type, NAICS/PSC and a link, plus the total matching award count. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/usaspending-awards

agency.description: Awarding toptier agency name or abbreviation (DOD, NASA, HHS, VA, DHS, ...)

keyword.description: Keyword search across award descriptions (min 3 chars). Alias: q

recipient.description: Recipient name, UEI or DUNS (free text)

type.description: contracts (default), idvs, grants, loans, direct_payments, other
